items.title: Apple, Meta reject OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans, leaving crypto firms as the ones to watch
items.summary: Strategy, Coinbase, Circle and Robinhood are among six companies from the venture’s initial selection with no disclosed objection, after 90% of issuers opted out.

items.title: U.S. prediction markets regulator issues demand that clashes directly with courts
items.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission said regulated exchanges can't cut off customers state-by-state, but firms like Kalshi are under court orders to do so.

items.title: The crypto industry has found new ways to grow. Making money from them is another story
items.summary: Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle are expanding into stablecoins, payments and prediction markets, but their latest earnings show how hard it is to escape crypto's boom-and-bust cycles.

items.title: Thailand moves to block Bitget as crypto exchange's local acquisition faces uncertainty
items.summary: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, alleging it ran an unlicensed crypto exchange for Thai users from 2022 to 2025.

items.title: U.S. added 165,000 jobs in October, blowing past 65,000 estimate
items.summary: The unemployment rate unexpectedly fell to 4.1%. The strong showing surely puts a December rate hike in play, but next week's inflation numbers and the fate of the stock market could prove more important.

items.title: Over $1 billion in bullish bets liquidated while ETF flows suggest no help in spot market
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 6, 2026

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin flatlines under $76,000 as stock bounce loses steam into the close
items.summary: The Nasdaq gained just 1.1%, while the S&amp;P 500 only edged higher, and the DJIA lost more ground.

items.title: Bitcoin steadies after AI-led selloff as eyes turn to latest U.S. jobs figures
items.summary: Bitcoin bounced from around $75,200 after Thursday’s AI-led selloff, which drove more than $1 billion in liquidations, as traders await the U.S. jobs report.

items.title: Bitcoin recovers $76,000 level as ETFs shed $430 million after tech rout
items.summary: Bitcoin recovered above $76,000 Friday after dropping below that level during Thursday's tech-driven market rout.

items.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains and 15% levy on DeFi income
items.summary: Investors will have 12 months to declare past crypto gains without late-filing penalties, though questions remain over crypto-to-crypto swaps.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: US Treasury cuts off MEXC over alleged $16B in illicit transactions
items.summary: The US Treasury bureau FinCEN on Friday ordered US financial institutions to stop processing transfers involving MEXC Global.

items.title: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card details, personal data and crypto wallet information
items.summary: The crypto debit card provider said customer funds remained safe despite the exposure of sensitive financial and personal information.

items.title: Binance hack is ‘cyber war,’ TRM Labs executive says
items.summary: TRM Labs executive Ari Redbord called for governments to take offensive action against North Korean hackers following the record $6.3 billion Binance theft.

items.title: US 401(k) proposal leaves door open to altcoins, but hurdles remain
items.summary: While the proposal doesn’t exclude altcoins and smaller cryptocurrencies, experts say they could face challenges getting into retirement plans.

items.title: Russia finalizes crypto trading rules ahead of Nov. 17 rollout
items.summary: The rules allow retail investors to trade BTC, ETH and USDT through regulated intermediaries, with Moscow Exchange planning to launch crypto trading in December.

items.title: Strive buys 15,124 Bitcoin in October, closes in on top treasury holders
items.summary: Bitcoin treasury company Strive reported $509 million in third-quarter net income and purchased 15,124 BTC in October, bringing its total holdings to 43,124 BTC.

items.title: Bitcoin price dips under $75K as crypto markets miss tech-stock rebound
items.summary: BTC price action stayed weak after US nonfarm payrolls data significantly beat forecasts, increasing bets of a December interest-rate hike.

items.title: What Democrats’ US midterm sweep means for the CLARITY Act
items.summary: The CLARITY Act faces a new test as Democrats control Congress, raising questions over consumer protections, ethics and what the crypto industry may have to concede.

items.title: Nigeria sets new crypto licensing rules, bans algorithmic stablecoins
items.summary: Nigeria has banned algorithmic stablecoins and introduced reserve requirements for issuers as it expands central bank oversight of crypto payment services.

items.title: Treasury Cuts Crypto Exchange MEXC Off From US Financial System
items.summary: FinCEN’s order, part of Operation Economic Outcast, bars U.S. institutions from any transfers to or from MEXC, which Treasury says facilitated $16 billion in illicit finance tied to Iran, North Korea and Russia.

items.title: Greece Passes Crypto Tax Law With 10% Gains Levy, 15% on Staking and DeFi
items.summary: Greece has approved a crypto tax framework with a €500 ($557) annual gains threshold and new rules for staking and DeFi income, but lawmakers left important questions about token swaps unresolved.

items.title: Why a Hyperliquid Treasury Firm Wants to Become a US Futures Broker
items.summary: Hyperliquid Strategies has applied to become a U.S. futures commission merchant, a move that could let Americans trade perpetual futures on permissioned Hyperliquid markets, pending regulatory approval.

items.title: Paraguay Protests Over Bank Lockout Intensify as Impeachment Vote Nears
items.summary: Savers locked out of Ueno Bank burned their cards, booed a former presidential candidate out of the crowd, and watched Congress move to remove President Peña.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $430 Million as Tech Rout Tests Wall Street Buyers
items.summary: Fidelity and BlackRock led Thursday's Bitcoin ETF withdrawals as a technology-stock selloff rattled risk assets.

items.title: US Sanctions 45 More Targets Tied to Alleged Crypto Scam Empire Prince Group
items.summary: OFAC targeted offshore companies and associates it says helped Prince Group executives hide assets and dodge earlier sanctions.

items.title: Crypto Card Provider Gnosis Pay Says Hackers Accessed Customer Data
items.summary: Gnosis Pay said hackers accessed customer information on the legacy system behind its branded cards, though funds weren’t affected and its enterprise card platform was untouched.

items.title: Crypto Liquidations Top $1 Billion as Bitcoin Tests 11-Week Low
items.summary: Bitcoin fell toward $75,500 after AI stocks plunged, and over $1 billion in the crypto derivatives market has been wiped out.

items.title: Anthropic IPO Valuation Could Be Slashed in Half to $1T After AI Stock Rout: Report
items.summary: Investors told The Wall Street Journal that the $1.5 trillion target now looks too high, as prediction markets bet on a December listing.

items.title: $3.1B in Stolen Binance Crypto Has Yet to Be Laundered: Elliptic
items.summary: The attackers have used more than 20,000 wallets on 16 blockchains so far, but the bulk of the stolen ETH and Bitcoin hasn't moved.
